info.title: Rollo API
info.description: Rollo backend: accounts, trips, shared rolls and the reveal at the end.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, only on the errors the app has to tell apart.

linkChallenge.description: base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 of a random verifier the app keeps on the phone (PKCE-style, 43 chars). Only with it does the email include a magic link, and the link only works with that verifier (`/auth/email/verify-link`). Without it (old app builds) the email carries only the code.

token.description: Session token (Bearer). Valid for 365 days; store it on the phone

isNew.description: true while the profile is incomplete (no name or no username): show the profile step

name.description: null until the profile is completed

username.description: Unique handle, lowercase, without the @ (the app shows it as @username); null until chosen

avatarUrl.description: Path (the app prefixes the API base URL), e.g. /avatars/<userId>/<version>.jpg; null if none

bio.description: Profile description (up to 3 lines); null if none

badge.description: Profile badge assigned by hand (founder = Founder, first_edition = First Edition); null if none

ProfileVisibility.description: Who can see your bio and featured photos: your friends only, or anyone signed in. Name, username and avatar are always visible

code.description: 6-character code from the email (letters and digits, no 0/O/1/I/L). Case-insensitive; spaces and dashes are ignored

token.description: Token from the magic link in the email (the `t` parameter of its fragment)

verifier.description: The verifier whose SHA-256 was sent as `linkChallenge` to `/auth/email/start` (43–128 chars of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~`). Without the right one the link fails like a wrong token.

idToken.description: Google ID token from Google Sign-In on the phone (a JWT signed by Google)

identityToken.description: Identity token from Sign in with Apple on the phone (a JWT signed by Apple)

name.description: Full name Apple gave the app (only on the first sign-in). Suggested as the profile name if the account has none; trimmed, single spaces, cut to 30 characters

registrationsOpen.description: false while new accounts cannot be created (the app shows the waitlist instead of sign-up).

momentDay.description: Trip-local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the daily moment this photo answers. The member must have a moment for that day (409 otherwise, or if it already has a photo). Moment photos don't use the photo quota. Photos only.

Ids the guest is not in (or that no longer exist) are dropped; if none is left the photo goes to all the guest's groups (to all the groups, for an organizer). Retrying the same `id` never changes them.

pairedMediaId.description: Marks this photo as the selfie of a moment: the id of the member's own moment photo in the same rollo (400 otherwise). The selfie takes its moment day from that photo and doesn't use the photo quota.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; null when there are no more items (always null without cursor or limit)

thumbhash.description: ThumbHash in base64. Always returned, also before the reveal, on purpose: it only encodes blurry colors (~25 bytes), the photo cannot be reconstructed from it.

groupIds.description: Event groups the photo was sent to. Always empty in a regular trip.

userId.description: The author's user id (to open their profile)

files.description: Download paths; only after the reveal, except for the photos of a daily moment (main and linked image), which any active member gets as soon as they are uploaded

featureBlocked.description: Only after the reveal: the author does not let others feature it (they still can)

likedByMe.description: Only after the reveal: you like it

commentCount.description: After the reveal, and before it on a daily moment's photo: how many comments you see on it (not the deleted ones, nor those of blocked users or ones you reported). Always 0 for videos

files.description: Download paths (the linked image of a moment is visible to active members as soon as it is uploaded)

originalAvailable.description: false once the linked image's original was deleted (the `original` path then serves the display file)

selfie.description: Only on moment photos: the selfie taken with it (null if there is none yet). Selfies are never items of their own. it comes with files and dimensions right away

likeCount.description: How many people like it (the same counter as in its rollo)

FeaturedPhoto.description: A photo on someone's profile. Never includes the rollo, the caption or the exact location

post.summary: Request a login code by email
post.description: Sends a 6-character code (letters and digits, no 0/O/1/I/L; valid 5 minutes, 5 attempts) and, only when `linkChallenge` is sent, a magic link for the same attempt (`<LOGIN_LINK_URL>#t=<token>&e=<email>`, see `/auth/email/verify-link`), bound to that challenge. Using either one consumes both. A new request invalidates the previous codes. Rate limited per email and per IP, and capped globally per day (429). Works for new and existing users alike, and answers the same while new registrations are closed (the rejection comes when verifying).

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

post.summary: Exchange the emailed code for a session token
post.description: Creates the user on the first successful verification. `isNew` is true while the user has no name. The code is case-insensitive and spaces or dashes are ignored; a malformed code is answered like a wrong one. While new registrations are closed (`GET /config` → `registrationsOpen: false`), an email with no account gets 403 `{ error, code: "REGISTRATIONS_CLOSED" }` here (after the code or link checks out), and existing accounts sign in as always.

post.summary: Exchange the emailed magic-link token for a session token
post.description: Same result as `/auth/email/verify`, with the token from the link's fragment instead of the code. Needs the `verifier` whose SHA-256 was sent as `linkChallenge` to `/auth/email/start`: the link only signs in the phone that asked for it. Shares the code's expiry, attempts and single use: a wrong or missing token or verifier uses up an attempt, and after the link or the code is used neither works again. Attempts started without a challenge have no link, so this always fails for them. Every failure answers the same 400. Only POST: the token is never accepted in a URL. While new registrations are closed (`GET /config` → `registrationsOpen: false`), an email with no account gets 403 `{ error, code: "REGISTRATIONS_CLOSED" }` here (after the code or link checks out), and existing accounts sign in as always.

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token
post.description: Same result as `/auth/email/verify`. The token must be signed by Google, issued for one of our OAuth clients (`GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS`), not expired, and carry an email Google verified; any failure is the same 400. The Google account id finds the user it was linked to before (even if its email changed); otherwise the verified email signs into that email's account or creates it, and links it. An existing account is only linked when Google owns the address (Gmail, or a Workspace domain matching `hd`); for any other address with an account the answer is 409 (sign in with the emailed code instead). An account without a name gets the Google profile name (single spaces, up to 30 characters) as a suggestion: it stays incomplete (`isNew`) until it has a username, so the profile step shows it prefilled. 503 when Google sign-in is not configured, or in degraded mode for an email without an account. While new registrations are closed, a Google account with no Rollo account (no linked identity, no account with that email) gets 403 `{ error, code: "REGISTRATIONS_CLOSED" }`.

503.description: Storage limit reached; new uploads are paused

post.summary: Sign in with a Sign in with Apple identity token
post.description: Same result as `/auth/email/verify` and the same rules as `/auth/google`. The token must be signed by Apple, issued for one of our bundle ids (`APPLE_CLIENT_IDS`) and not expired; if it carries an email, Apple must have verified it. Any failure is the same 400. The Apple account id finds the user it was linked to before (later tokens may come without an email); otherwise the email signs into that email's account or creates it, and links it. An existing account is only linked when Apple owns the address (iCloud, or the Hide My Email relay); any other address with an account answers 409 (sign in with the emailed code). A first sign-in without an email is a 400. `name`, which Apple gives only on the first sign-in, prefills an account without a name. 503 when Apple sign-in is not configured, or in degraded mode for an email without an account. While new registrations are closed, an Apple account with no Rollo account gets 403 `{ error, code: "REGISTRATIONS_CLOSED" }`.

503.description: Storage limit reached; new uploads are paused

get.description: No token. `registrationsOpen` is false while a superadmin has closed new registrations: the app then shows its waitlist instead of sign-up (existing accounts still sign in). The value can lag up to a minute after a change.

get.summary: Preview an event by its invite code
get.description: No token. The name, cover and groups the guest picks from before joining (`POST /trips/join`), and whether the event was already revealed. 404 'Código inválido' if the code does not exist or belongs to a regular trip. Limited per IP (429, a roomy budget: a venue shares one IP). CORS: open to the website (`https://rolloproject.com`, `https://www.rolloproject.com`), GET only.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

post.description: No token. For people who cannot sign up yet (registrations closed). Always 204 for valid input, whether or not the email was already listed, confirmed, throttled or over a daily cap: nothing about the list is revealed. 400 for an invalid email or `consent` other than `true`. Sends one confirmation email (a confirm and an unsubscribe link) at most once per address per 24 h; someone who unsubscribed and posts again gets a new one. Already confirmed addresses get nothing. Capped per IP and globally per day (still 204, nothing sent). 502 only if the email provider fails.

get.summary: My daily moments in all my rollos
get.description: The moments of the caller for every rollo where they are an active member, the moment is on, the rollo is not revealed and it is within the scheduling window (from 3 days before the start until the end). One call instead of one `GET /trips/{tripId}/moments` per rollo. Each rollo carries exactly what that endpoint would return for it, possibly empty (so the app can cancel old notifications). Like the per-rollo endpoint, the first time it draws and stores the missing moments and never re-draws. Ordered by rollo id.

200.description: My moments in all my rollos

428.description: Profile incomplete: set a name and a username first

patch.description: Send any of name, username, bio and profileVisibility; fields left out are not changed. The name is shown in every rollo you are part of and does not have to be unique. The username must be unique (case-insensitive); setting your own current one is a no-op. 409 if someone else has it. The bio is trimmed, an empty one clears it (null), and it allows up to 150 characters and 3 lines (400 otherwise). profileVisibility is "friends" (default) or "public"; any other value is a 400.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the account. In every rollo you belong to (also those you were removed from), your photos and videos are deleted (database rows and files, even after the reveal) and your membership is removed. If you created a rollo, the oldest remaining active admin becomes its creator (with no admins, the oldest active member, who is promoted). If no active members remain, the whole rollo is deleted with all its files. Your reports and blocks (made and received), push tokens, settings and likes (yours, and the ones on your photos) are deleted too. Your friendships, friend links and claims, avatar, sessions and pending login codes are deleted too (your friends keep their rollos). The same email can sign up again later as a brand-new user.

post.summary: Get a URL to upload your avatar
post.description: Send the exact byte size of the JPEG (`sizeBytes`, max 2 MB; 400 otherwise). Returns a URL signed for exactly that Content-Length to PUT the JPEG straight to R2. Then call POST /me/avatar/complete. 503 when the storage limit is reached. A previous upload that was never completed is discarded. Each call generates a new random file name, so the avatar URL changes when you replace it.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

503.description: Storage limit reached; new uploads are paused

post.description: Checks that the file is in R2, is a JPEG (verified by its magic bytes) and is at most 2 MB, makes it your avatar and deletes the previous one. Otherwise the upload is discarded and the response is a 400.

429.description: Daily limit or rate limit reached

put.description: Registers an Expo push token (ExponentPushToken[...] or ExpoPushToken[...], URL-encoded in the path) for your account. Idempotent: calling it again only refreshes when it was last seen. A token belongs to one account at a time: if another account had it (same phone, another account), it moves to yours. 400 if it is not an Expo push token.

delete.description: Stops sending pushes to this token for your account (call it when signing out). Idempotent; another account's token is left alone.

patch.description: Send any subset of the notification preferences; the ones left out do not change. Unknown keys or non-boolean values are a 400. Returns the full settings.

428.description: Profile incomplete: set a name and a username first

Public (no token) so it can be used directly as an image URL, also by the event preview and the website. Only the event's current cover is served; file names are random, so older or guessed ones return 404.

get.summary: Check if a username is available
get.description: Normalizes the username (optional @, lowercase) and says whether nobody else has it. Your own current username counts as available. 400 if it breaks the format rules. For checking while typing.

post.description: Asks to become friends with someone whose profile you can open. They are friends only once the receiver accepts. If they already sent you one, you become friends at once (`friends`). Sending again while it is pending, or to a friend, is not an error. A request the receiver rejected is silent: you still get `sent`, nothing reaches them until 30 days after the rejection. Notifies the receiver (`friendRequest`). 400 to yourself, 404 if the user does not exist or there is a block in either direction, 429 past 30 sent requests in 24 hours.

428.description: Profile incomplete: set a name and a username first

get.description: Finds people to add as friends: the username starts with q, or the name or any word of it does (case and accents ignored). Never lists yourself, your friends, anyone with a block in either direction, or accounts without a username or a name. Order: exact username first, then most mutual friends, then by name. At most 20, no paging. 400 if q has fewer than 2 or more than 30 characters once trimmed and without the leading @. Limited per user (429).

schema.description: What to look for: a username (with or without @) or the start of a name or of any word of it. Case and accents are ignored. 2 to 30 characters once trimmed and without the leading @; otherwise 400

parameters.name: q

get.description: Name, username, avatar, bio and friend counts are always visible. Featured photos and the full friend list only if canSee: it is you, a friend, or the profile is public. Never includes the email. 404 if the user does not exist.

post.description: Returns an 8-character code (the link is https://rolloproject.com/friends#<code>; rollo://friends/<code> is still accepted) valid for 1 hour and reusable while it lives. Generating a new one invalidates the previous links of the user.

post.summary: Become friends with whoever made a link
post.description: Send exactly one of `code` (a link that is still valid) or `claimToken` (from /friend-links/claim, valid 24 hours, single use). The friendship is symmetric and needs no acceptance.
